# dm-csv-061

## Instruction
Calculate the dates of the earliest and most recent reviews, the total number of private rooms, and the average listing price.

## About Dataset
New York City has a variety of Airbnb listings to meet the high demand for temporary lodging for travelers, with several different price levels, room types, and locations. Practice your skills in importing and cleaning data and data manipulation and report insights to a real estate start-up!
